Current observed staking model 0x3474b74139c192d0781812ca70cc410d19cb6a2d returns zero outside 30 minutes through 1461 days. Owner may replace the model; bounds/rates are not guaranteed to remain fixed.

restake acts only on callers vault index, may pull additional caller HAKKA, resets unlockTime to now+time and must extend the former unlock and produce at least the existing receipt amount. It can extend a lock without adding capital. It is not an early exit or a reward claim.

unstake acts only on callers vault after unlockTime; it burns callers sHAKKA and returns floor(receiptAmount*remainingVaultHAKKA/remainingVaultReceipts) HAKKA to the fixed payout recipient. Owning transferred sHAKKA alone does not transfer the original vault mapping; a lock owner who transferred/farmed receipts must recover enough to burn. No early-redemption bypass or guaranteed market value exists.

Reward-pool stake/stakeFor pull caller sHAKKA and credit the caller/named beneficiary internal reward stake; withdraw releases only callers recorded sHAKKA. stakeFor gifts the stake and reward rights to beneficiary. exit combines full own withdrawal and getReward; with zero staked balance it reverts due positive withdrawal requirement. No additional pool lock is present, but the original HAKKA vault maturity still applies.

getReward sends accrued HAKKA into VestingVault 0x51f12323820b3c0077864990d9e6ad9604238ed6 for caller, NOT liquid HAKKA to caller. Reward accounting is time-limited by periodFinish, integer floor rounding and mutable distributor funding; current primary farm displays 0.00% APR, so no positive emissions/yield promise. VestingVault withdrawal is not admitted here; a complete reward cashout workflow is not promised.

Reward accounting is time-limited by periodFinish, integer floor rounding and mutable distributor funding; current primary farm displays 0.00% APR, so no positive emissions/yield promise. VestingVault withdrawal is not admitted here; a complete reward cashout workflow is not promised.

Stake/unstake/receipt-pool bodies deduct no explicit entry/exit fee, but lock duration, receipt conversion, funding and vesting can materially affect liquidity/value. HAKKA price, contract custody and dependency failure risks remain. Owner-only model/distribution/rescue methods, ERC20 approvals/transfers and authority management are excluded. Root rescue cannot extract HAKKA; pool rescue excludes HAKKA and its sHAKKA stake token. Model and reward-vesting dependencies are not a financial safety guarantee.

sourceSemantics.fundingAndOwnership: Root stake pulls msg.sender HAKKA into root and grants per-to vault. restake/unstake operate caller-index mapping only. Pool stake/stakeFor pull msg.sender receipt and credit internal beneficiary; withdraw/exit/getReward caller-only.
sourceSemantics.unitsFees: HAKKA and receipt units 18 decimals; underlying locked principal is recorded separately from variable-rate receipt units. No explicit user entry/exit fee in selected root/pool bodies; rounding floors.
sourceSemantics.lockAndReceipt: Current model valid 30minutes..1461days; stake receipts depend on rate and duration; restake must extend unlock and not reduce receipt grant. Transferable receipt is not transferable vault ownership. After maturity receipt burn redeems pro-rata recorded remaining HAKKA.
sourceSemantics.rewardsAndCustody: Time-weighted funded-pool reward accrual ends at periodFinish; claim moves HAKKA to VestingVault for caller, not liquid wallet payout. Farming receipt must be withdrawn to burn for principal. Current 0% UI does not alone prove retirement nor justify rewards guarantee.
sourceSemantics.governanceBoundary: Staking automatically updates internal votingPower, but no votes/proposals/delegation/authority setup selected. Owner model/emissions changes and unrelated-token rescue excluded.
